description: CsNaSiO₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. There are four inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Cs-O bond lengths are 3.14 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Cs-O bond lengths are 3.14 Å. In the third Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.06-3.33 Å. In the fourth Cs site, Cs is bonded in a hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (3.39 Å) and three longer (3.47 Å) Cs-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.62 Å) and two longer (1.67 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Cs, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Cs, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Cs, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Cs, two equivalent Na, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms.
